findings: Pre-existing: release_verify.ps1 requires every hard-suite row to be match 1 and requires Threads 1/2/4 rows to be identical after stripping nodes/qnodes/tt_hits. At commit 54080cd Threads=2 and Threads=4 produce deterministic but different rows (11 match-0 rows each), so the harness assertion is stale relative to the documented threaded search behavior (several threaded parity cases are XFAIL by design). No release-verify evidence directory exists for HEAD; the only one (release-verify-eefb3e8e...) contains only cmake-version files.
koi-bench --help usage text omits --nnue and the profile JSON has no NNUE identity field.
KOI-NNUE (koi-sf-v1) matches 60/64 on the default hard suite at Threads=1 versus 64/64 for the classical evaluator.
